car: 2012 Audi A6 C7 (4G) 2.0 TDI, UK, MLB, VIN WAUZZZ4GXCN000000

modules.what: The dials, warning lamps and centre driver information display in front of the driver; its long coding also tells it which equipment the car has and how to show units, clock and chimes.
modules.notes: Coding is 11 bytes, the same length as the two labelled C7 clusters on vagcode.info (2012 A7 4G8 920 931 R, 2015 A6 4G8 920 984 K). UDS on this car, so the only module here the app can write with public information. Byte 0 bit 5 (right-hand drive) is set, which fits a UK car and suggests the C7 label layout applies. Multi-bit fields (seat belt, model, tyre circumference, fuel unit, consumption unit, language, country) are not decoded: the label pages show a fixed option name, not the value.

modules.what: Runs the climate control: temperatures, fan, air flaps and the air conditioning request; on the C7 it also holds the heated seat step-down timers.
modules.notes: Coding is 5 bytes. The 2012 A7 (4G0 820 043 L, 3603007E24) and a 2015 A6 (4G0 820 043 AQ, 64812018C9) also have 5 bytes, but no public page labels the bits of this module. Only low-confidence hints exist (byte 1 bits 3 and 4 auxiliary heating or ventilation, byte 4 bit 6 climate styles blocked on an A8 D4), so no setting is offered. Heated seat timers are adaptation channels, not coding (see vag-tweaks.md A6C7-049).

modules.what: Reads the ultrasonic parking sensors, sounds the warning tones and can send the parking graphic to the MMI screen.
modules.notes: Coding is 3 bytes, the same as the 2012 A7 (4H0 919 475 R, 992B03) and a 2015 A6 (4H0 919 475 AA, A8C105). No C7 label page exists. The MMI graphic bit (byte 0 bit 4, login 71679) comes from vag-coding.net guides for the A4 B8 and Q5 8R; vag-coding.net's own A6 C7 and A7 C7 pages give an older 7-digit short coding for address 76, which does not fit this car. The switch-off speed is an adaptation: vag-coding.net says channel 233, 0 to 20 km/h; the C7 community list says channel 23.

modules.what: Links the car's separate data networks so the modules can talk to each other, holds the list of fitted modules and the battery data, and is the diagnostic entry point.
modules.notes: Coding is 5 bytes (00CD074400). Two 2012 A7 gateways of the same family (4G0 907 468 G and E, software 0214 and 0213) are coded 00CD077D00; only byte 3 differs from this car (44 against 7D). No public page names any bit of this coding. The installed-module list is a separate gateway function (see vag-sources.md section 1). No settings found.

modules.what: Switches the exterior lights, daytime running lights, indicators, wipers and washers, and the interior and footwell lighting.
modules.notes: Part number and coding not read from this car. The 2012 A7 has 4H0 907 063 BN with 30 bytes of coding. KWP2000 on TP2.0 on the C7, so writes need the KWP route. Existing app items cover DRL, fogs, footwell lights and tourist mode. vag-coding.net confirms tourist mode in MMI at byte 4 bit 6 (already in items.ts as c7-tourist). A highway light bit (above 140 km/h) is published but in a sub-coding, so it is not offered.

settings.title: Chime at 120 km/h
settings.summary: A chime sounds when the car passes 120 km/h (75 mph).
settings.note: Label "Speed Warning at 120 kph (75 mph) active" on two C7 clusters and two MLB sibling clusters; vag-coding.net (A4 B8) names the same option in byte 0. No C7 owner report. Byte 0 bits 2 to 4 are the seat belt field and bit 5 is right-hand drive: leave them unchanged. Currently off on this car.
